name: GPU-based SVO Construction and Mipmap Generation
definition: A GPU compute shader pipeline that constructs a Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) by allocating nodes per level, writing leaf nodes from a fragment list, and generating mipmaps level-by-level from leaves up to the root.
summary: This GPU compute pipeline constructs Sparse Voxel Octrees and generates mipmaps by explicitly detailing dispatch dimensions and loop structures, unlike its parent which focuses on high-level logic.
